RD_LOCAL_RULES_REQUIRED.message: Schema local rules require the actual typed Rust model. Structural validation does not run defaults, normalization, coercion or callbacks.

RD_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE.message: The requested feature is not present in this exact published version. Review the feature and version choice without silently upgrading.

RD_VERSION_UNKNOWN.message: This version is outside the packaged knowledge. Inspect its exact published API before suggesting a repair.

missing.message: A required input field is missing. Missing, explicit null and a default are distinct; test the actual model and preserve the intended requirement.

custom.message: A user validator rejected the value. The CLI cannot infer the callback's business rule; inspect and test the actual callback.

json_schema.message: A dynamic JSON Schema assertion failed. This does not establish typed callback execution, normalization, default insertion or format enforcement.

greater_than_equal.message: The value must meet an inclusive lower bound. Preserve the intended bound and test below, at and above it on the actual model.

less_than_equal.message: The value must meet an inclusive upper bound. Preserve the intended bound and test below, at and above it on the actual model.

too_short.message: The value is shorter than the configured minimum length. Test the actual type and boundary without removing the requirement.

too_long.message: The value exceeds the configured maximum length. Test the actual type and boundary without removing the requirement.

extra_forbidden.message: An input object contains an unknown field. Check input aliases and the intended contract; do not silently enable ignoring extra fields.

email.message: The typed email constraint rejected the string. Test the actual model; a JSON Schema format annotation alone is not proof of equivalent enforcement.

context_missing.message: This callback requires caller-supplied context. Supply the expected Arc<T> through the matching with_context API; parsed models do not retain it.

context_type_mismatch.message: The supplied context has the wrong concrete type. Match the callback require_data::<T>() contract; do not skip validation.

async_validation_required.message: This model requires asynchronous validation. Use its async parse or validation entrypoint and await it; synchronous parsing must not silently omit the check.
